## Scope

Describe the protocol, runtime, adapter, SDK, documentation, or test change.

## Public-data confirmation

- [ ] Uses only public documentation and sanitized fixtures
- [ ] Contains no credentials, private endpoints, customer payloads, production logs, private prices, or routing weights
- [ ] `pnpm scan:public` passes

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Public contract changes include tests and compatibility notes
